main_body: Wooden cart bed (rows ~10-21) carrying three grey pots of flowers, with a shaft handle on the right and two legs/wheels below
top_band: Mid-brown at rows ~10-13, mostly hidden behind the pots, with a dark shadow row at ~13. It is not a distinct lighter surface across the width. Only a small lighter patch at the right end (x~26-29) hints at a top.
evidence: Down the middle column, the pot bottoms run into a dark row at ~13. Below that, a broad brown face runs from rows 14 to 20 with plank grain and no lighter top band or front-edge highlight. The 3-4 rows above it are occluded by the pots and read as a back edge. The cart bed is a front elevation with a thin, ambiguous top, unlike the reference cart bed, which has a clear lighter horizontal band above its face. The flowers' foliage tops are small details and earn no credit.

style.evidence: The flowers use several greens plus red and yellow dots, and the pots have 3-4 grey steps with vertical shading. The brown cart bed has grain and a dark shadow band, and the outlines lean dark brown rather than black. The bed has only about 3-4 brown steps and the wheel and legs are simple. The piece is slightly thinner than the roofed well and stall references but does not look sticker-like next to them.
